investment_theses.thesis: Bitcoin declines 15–25% in near term (May–June 2026) as Nvidia earnings volatility spills into crypto via forced liquidations and macro tightening fears, then recovers sharply in Q3–Q4 on prediction market legalization tailwinds.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: 'Bitcoin risks falling below $60,000 as Nvidia earnings threaten to deepen crypto sell-off'
CNBC: Trump sold $1M NVDA post-Huang briefing; equity volatility rising
CoinDesk: Senate Democrats backing off CFTC ban; legislative momentum building
Crypto trending: BTC volatility correlated with tech sector; TAO, HYPE weakness
investment_theses.counter_view: Federal Reserve cuts rates faster than expected (Warsh signal), which re-inflates risk assets; prediction markets already legal in forward contracts (Kalshi) so legalization event is priced.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC June 2026 out-of-the-money puts (hedge near-term downside); long BTC September–December 2026 calls (capture post-Q2 recovery); or use BTC/SPY correlation inverse and short SPY via leveraged ETF (PSQ) for 2–4 weeks, then flip.

investment_theses.thesis: Nvidia stock outperforms broader tech sector through 2026 despite Trump pressure on Jensen Huang because board discipline, enterprise AI ROI acceleration, and competitive moat justify 50+ multiples—political noise is temporary.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Trump trading activity ($97.5M in NVDA accounts, then $1M sale) is signaling uncertainty, not conviction short
BBC: Nvidia board 'ruled out Huang return'—board discipline is signal of stability
CNBC Warsh: 'AI at a turning point'—enterprise CapEx cycle accelerating
Cointelegraph: Nvidia shares fell 4% on Huang return denial, recoverable on Q2 earnings
investment_theses.counter_view: Trump political pressure escalates to executive action (tariffs, export controls on chips); Huang reinstatement campaign gains traction and creates corporate governance crisis.
investment_theses.expression: Long NVDA vs. short SPY (beta-adjusted hedge); or long NVDA June/September 2026 calls; or use QQQ call spread (long $450c / short $500c June expiry) to capture upside with lower cost.

investment_theses.thesis: U.S. interest rates decline 50–75 bps by end of 2026 as labor market softness from AI acceleration emerges; Fed chair Warsh pivots dovish; this lifts Bitcoin and growth equity multiples, compressing DXY.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Kevin Warsh explicitly raises 'tough questions on jobs' in context of AI turning point
Fed communication pattern: Warsh is macro hawk-turned-pragmatist; likely to embrace data-dependent cuts if unemployment ticks up
Crypto macro: Prediction market legalization removes tail risk of CFTC clamps; reduces USD carry trades liquidation risk
CoinDesk: Senate Democratic pressure on CFTC suggests crypto-friendly policy regime emerging
investment_theses.counter_view: Inflation re-accelerates (energy shock, fiscal spending); Fed holds rates; Trump tariffs push CPI higher; DXY rallies, Bitcoin and growth assets compress.
investment_theses.expression: Long DBC or USO (commodities hedge); short DXY via FXE put spreads; long TLT or IEF (Treasury long duration ETFs); long BTC and long QQQ (leveraged via TQQQ or call spreads). Or pair trade: long 10-year Treasury futures, short 2-year (curve steepener).

investment_theses.thesis: Cryptocurrency sector undergoes technical correction (BTC to $55K–$58K, ETH to $2.0K–$2.3K) through May–June driven by Nvidia earnings shock and macro hawkishness, but July–September 2026 recovery is sharp as prediction market ETFs and spot Bitcoin ETF inflows resume.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Multiple reports of BTC downside risk; Aschenbrenner's AI hedge fund bought before October rout, now positions vulnerable
CNBC Warsh: Explicit job impact concerns = risk-off, temporary
Crypto trending: TAO, HYPE, LIT weakness; retail positioning extended
Kalshi launch: Stock trading feature coming; regulatory clarity accelerating; reduces tail risk
investment_theses.counter_view: No bounce; crypto enters bear market as macro stays tight, spot Bitcoin ETF demand exhausts, and prediction market legalization fails (new CFTC enforcement). BTC tests $40K–$50K.
investment_theses.expression: Buy BTC dips below $58K via spot, hold for September (3–4 month hold). Or long BTC 3-month puts (June expiry) at $55K strike, sell September $45K puts; create profitable collar. Or via proxy: long BITO calls (Bitcoin futures ETF) June/September expiry, out-of-the-money.

investment_theses.thesis: Prediction market infrastructure (Polymarket, Kalshi) becomes a key alpha-generation tool for institutions in H2 2026 as regulatory tailwinds solidify; implied probability mismatches vs. fundamental odds in U.S. election, Fed policy, and crypto will create edge; Manifold volume and liquidity expand 5–10x.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Senate Democrats explicitly backing prediction market traders vs. CFTC ban
CNBC: Kalshi launches stock trading, signaling product-market fit and institutional adoption
Hacker News: AI and software engineering culture primes educated retail for prediction markets
Crypto trending: HYPE (Hyperliquid) prominence; derivatives infrastructure maturing
investment_theses.counter_view: CFTC enforcement intensifies despite Senate noise; Kalshi stock trading launch delayed; retail participants get wiped in forced liquidations (see Lighter exploit story); prediction market volume remains niche.
investment_theses.expression: Meta-bet: Accumulate small positions in Polymarket / Kalshi cap tables if available via secondary markets or VC syndicates; or long portfolios of prediction market YES shares (buy low-probability events that resolve yes mid-year, e.g., Fed cuts, BTC above $80K). Or use volatility arbitrage: long vol (VXX, UVXY) through June, then rotate to crypto vol (BTC realized vol ETPs) July–September.
